recipes.name: Master Guntur Powder (Guntur Karam)
steps: Heat 1 tsp oil in a pan and roast 1 tbsp chana dal and 1 tbsp urad dal until golden brown.
Add 2 tbsp coriander seeds and 1 tbsp cumin seeds; sauté until aromatic.
Add 1 cup dried Guntur red chillies and roast on low flame until they turn crisp.
Allow the roasted spices to cool completely.
Grind the spices with 4-6 raw garlic cloves and 1/2 tsp salt into a slightly coarse powder.
Turn off the flame and store in an airtight jar.

recipes.name: Idli
steps: Soak idli rice and urad dal with fenugreek for 6 hours.
Grind urad dal into smooth batter and rice into coarse batter.
Mix both together, add salt, and ferment for 8 hours.
Pour into greased moulds and steam for 10 minutes.
Turn off the flame and serve hot.

recipes.name: Plain Dosa
steps: Grind soaked rice and dal into a fine batter and ferment overnight.
Heat tawa and spread batter thin.
Drizzle oil and cook until crisp.
Turn off the flame and remove.

recipes.name: Pesarattu
steps: Grind soaked green gram with ginger and green chilli into batter.
Spread batter thick on a hot tawa and drizzle oil.
Cook both sides until brown.
Turn off the flame and serve.

recipes.name: Rava Upma
steps: Dry roast rava and set aside.
Sauté onion and chilli in oil.
Add water and salt; bring to a boil.
Slowly add rava while stirring; cook until thick.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Vegetable Upma
ingredients: carrot, french beans, green peas, and drumstick
steps: Sauté onion and carrot, french beans, green peas, and drumstick in oil.
Add water and salt; bring to a boil.
Add roasted rava slowly and cook until water is absorbed.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Uttapam
steps: Pour thick dosa batter on tawa.
Sprinkle chopped onion, chilli, and tomato.
Cook until base is golden and flip briefly.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Idiyappam
steps: Mix rice flour with boiling salted water into dough.
Press through idiyappam maker onto plates.
Steam for 10 minutes.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Pulihora
steps: Cook rice and cool; boil tamarind juice with salt and turmeric until thick.
Temper peanuts and chillies in oil; mix rice with paste and tempering.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Pongal
steps: Pressure cook rice and dal together until very soft.
Temper pepper, cumin, ginger, and cashews in ghee.
Mix tempering into the mash; turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Poha
steps: Wash and drain poha.
Sauté onion and chilli in oil with turmeric.
Add poha and salt; mix gently and turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Chapathi
steps: Knead flour, salt, and water into dough.
Roll into discs and cook on hot tawa.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Poori with Potato Curry
steps: Fry rolled dough discs in hot oil until puffed.
Sauté boiled potatoes with onion and turmeric for curry.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Poori
steps: Knead stiff dough and roll into small discs.
Deep fry in hot oil until puffed.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Semiya Upma
steps: Dry roast vermicelli; sauté onion and chilli in oil.
Add water and salt; boil and add vermicelli; cook until soft.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Tomato Omelette
steps: Beat eggs with chopped tomato and onion.
Cook on hot oiled pan until set.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Egg Bhurji
steps: Sauté onion and chilli in oil.
Add cracked eggs, turmeric, and salt; stir until dry.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Curd Rice
steps: Overcook rice until very soft and mash it while hot.
Mix with milk and curd once cooled to prevent souring.
Temper with mustard, ginger, green chillies, and curry leaves.
Garnish with pomegranate seeds or grated carrot.

recipes.name: Rava Dosa
steps: Mix rava and rice flour into thin batter.
Pour on hot tawa; sprinkle onion and cook until crisp.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Masala Dosa
steps: Spread dosa batter thin on tawa.
Add sautéed potato-onion masala in center and fold.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Set Dosa
steps: Pour small, thick dosas on tawa; cook covered until spongy.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Bread Toast
steps: Apply butter to bread slices.
Toast on hot tawa until golden brown.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Vegetable Sandwich
ingredients: carrot, french beans, green peas, and drumstick
steps: Boil and mash carrot, french beans, and green peas.
Spread on bread with butter and toast.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Idli with Sambar
steps: Steam idlis; boil dal and tamarind juice with sambar powder.
Serve idlis dipped in sambar; turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Dosa with Chutney
steps: Cook dosa on tawa; grind coconut and chilli for chutney.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Vada
steps: Grind soaked urad dal into thick batter; add onion and chilli.
Deep fry small donuts in oil until golden.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Rice with Pappu
steps: Prepare or take Master Guntur Powder (ap_ms_001).
Pressure cook toor dal; mash and temper with garlic and 1 tsp Guntur powder.
Serve with hot rice and turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Sambar with Rice
ingredients: carrot, french beans, green peas, and drumstick
steps: Pressure cook dal; boil carrot, french beans, green peas, and drumstick with tamarind and sambar powder.
Mix together and serve with rice; turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Pulusu
steps: Boil tamarind juice with onion, chilli, and salt until thick.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Avakaya Annam
steps: Mix hot rice with avakaya pickle and oil.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Gongura Pappu
steps: Prepare or take Master Guntur Powder (ap_ms_001).
Cook dal and gongura leaves; mash with garlic and 1 tsp Guntur powder.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Tomato Pappu
steps: Cook dal with tomatoes; mash and temper with garlic.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Cabbage Fry
steps: Prepare or take Master Guntur Powder (ap_ms_001).
Sauté cabbage with turmeric and 1 tsp Guntur powder until dry.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Beans Fry
steps: Sauté chopped french beans with coconut in oil.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Brinjal Curry
steps: Sauté onion and tomato; add brinjal and cook until soft.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Potato Fry
steps: Prepare or take Master Guntur Powder (ap_ms_001).
Sauté boiled potato cubes with turmeric and 1 tsp Guntur powder.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Cucumber Pachadi
steps: Mix chopped cucumber with curd and salt.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Beerakaya Curry
steps: Cook ridge gourd with chilli and salt until tender.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Ladys finger Fry
steps: Prepare or take Master Guntur Powder (ap_ms_001).
Sauté ladys finger with turmeric and 1 tsp Guntur powder until crisp.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Chikkudukaya Fry
steps: Sauté boiled broad beans with crushed peanuts in oil.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Egg Curry
steps: Prepare or take Master Guntur Powder (ap_ms_001).
Cook eggs in onion-tomato gravy with 1 tsp Guntur powder.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Chicken Curry
steps: Prepare or take Master Guntur Powder (ap_ms_001).
Cook chicken with ginger-garlic and 2 tsp Guntur powder until tender.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Fish Pulusu
steps: Prepare or take Master Guntur Powder (ap_ms_001).
Simmer fish in tamarind juice with 2 tsp Guntur powder.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Rasam
steps: Boil tomato and tamarind with pepper and cumin.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Vegetable Kurma
ingredients: carrot, french beans, green peas, and drumstick
steps: Cook carrot, french beans, green peas, and drumstick in coconut-spice gravy.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Pulihora
steps: Cook rice until grains are separate and let it cool on a wide plate.
Boil thick tamarind juice with salt and turmeric until it reaches a thick paste consistency.
Heat oil and temper with peanuts, chana dal, mustard seeds, and dry red chillies.
Mix the tamarind paste and the tempering thoroughly into the cooled rice.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Vegetable Pulao
ingredients: carrot, french beans, green peas, and drumstick
steps: Sauté cinnamon, cloves, and ginger-garlic paste in oil until aromatic.
Add mint leaves and chopped carrot, french beans, and green peas; sauté for 2 minutes.
Add washed rice, salt, and water in a 1:2 ratio.
Pressure cook for 2 whistles until rice is fluffy.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Poori & Aloo Masala
steps: Knead wheat flour with salt and water into a stiff dough; roll into small discs.
Boil and mash potatoes; sauté with onions, green chillies, and turmeric in oil.
Deep fry the poori discs in hot oil until they puff up.
Serve the puffed poories with the potato masala.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Ghee Rice
steps: Heat ghee and fry cashews, cinnamon, and cloves until golden.
Add washed basmati rice and sauté for 1 minute to coat with ghee.
Add water and salt; cook until the rice is tender and separate.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Tomato Rice
steps: Sauté onion and ginger-garlic paste in oil; add chopped tomatoes and turmeric.
Cook until tomatoes are mushy; add washed rice and salt.
Add water, cover, and pressure cook for 2 whistles.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Punugulu
steps: Mix fermented idli batter with finely chopped onion, green chilli, and cumin seeds.
Heat oil in a deep pan.
Drop small spoonfuls of batter into the hot oil.
Fry until golden brown and crispy.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Garelu (Vada)
steps: Grind soaked urad dal into a smooth, thick batter using very little water.
Add chopped green chilli, ginger, and salt; beat until the batter is light.
Shape into small donuts and deep fry in hot oil until golden.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Pakodi
steps: Mix sliced onions, gram flour, green chilli, and curry leaves with salt.
Add minimal water to make a thick, chunky mixture.
Drop small clusters into hot oil and fry until dark golden and crisp.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Mirchi Bajji
steps: Slit green chillies and remove seeds; dip in a thick besan and ajwain batter.
Deep fry in hot oil until the coating is golden and crisp.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Murukulu
steps: Knead rice flour, urad dal flour, butter, and sesame seeds into a soft dough.
Press spirals into hot oil using a murukku maker.
Fry on medium flame until crisp; turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Chekkalu
steps: Mix rice flour with soaked peanuts, sesame seeds, and ginger-chilli paste.
Flatten small balls of dough into thin discs.
Deep fry until golden and brittle; turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Kaara Pori
steps: Fry crushed garlic, peanuts, and red chillies in oil.
Add turmeric and salt; turn off the flame.
Toss with puffed rice until evenly coated and crisp.

recipes.name: Ragi Sankati
steps: Cook rice with extra water until mushy.
Add ragi flour on top and let it steam without stirring for 5 minutes.
Mix vigorously until smooth; shape into balls using ghee.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Vegetable Curry
ingredients: carrot, french beans, green peas, and drumstick
steps: Prepare or take Master Guntur Powder (ap_ms_001).
Sauté onion and ginger-garlic; add chopped tomatoes and 1 tsp Guntur powder.
Add carrot, french beans, green peas, and drumstick; cook until tender.
Turn off the flame.

recipes.name: Egg Dosa
steps: Prepare or take Master Guntur Powder (ap_ms_001).
Spread dosa batter; crack an egg on top and sprinkle onion and 1 tsp Guntur powder.
Cook until crisp and flip briefly; turn off the flame.
